definitions.explanation: Additional material at the end of a book or document containing supplementary information.
A free item included with a magazine or product as a bonus.

examples.japanese: {付録|ふろく}を{見|み}てください。
{詳|くわ}しいデータは{付録|ふろく}に{載|の}っている。
examples.english: Detailed data is included in the appendix.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}の{付録|ふろく}に{参考資料|さんこうしりょう}をまとめた。
examples.english: I compiled reference materials in the appendix of the thesis.

examples.japanese: {雑誌|ざっし}の{付録|ふろく}がほしい。
examples.english: I want the magazine's bonus item.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}の{付録|ふろく}はかわいいポーチだ。
examples.english: The bonus item with this magazine is a cute pouch.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{付録|ふろく}が{目当|めあ}てで{毎月|まいつき}この{雑誌|ざっし}を{買|か}っている。
examples.english: My daughter buys this magazine every month just for the bonus item.

notes:
USAGE: {付録|ふろく} has two common uses: (1) supplementary material in books/documents, and (2) free gifts included with magazines.

SENSE 1 - BOOK APPENDIX:
・{付録|ふろく}を{参照|さんしょう} (refer to appendix)
・{付録|ふろく}に{記載|きさい} (listed in the appendix)
・{付録|ふろく}A, {付録|ふろく}B (Appendix A, Appendix B)

SENSE 2 - MAGAZINE BONUS:
・{雑誌|ざっし}の{付録|ふろく} (magazine bonus item)
・{付録|ふろく}つき (with bonus item)
・Japanese magazines, especially fashion magazines, often include bonus items like bags, cosmetics, or stationery

RELATED TERMS:
・{序文|じょぶん} - preface
・{巻末|かんまつ} - end of volume
